Prepare step by step

  1. Leave an unsafe area and use emergency services for immediate danger.
  2. Follow insurer and emergency guidance about reasonable steps to prevent further damage.
  3. Preserve photos, receipts, notices and written estimates under your control.
  4. Ask the insurer, contractor and appropriate professional separate questions.
